The application identity, flavour, type and parameter names/types were observed through
read-only UCloud discovery on 22 October 2026. This is a schema subset, not a full application
response. It contains no account/project IDs, credentials, recordings or transcripts.

It demonstrates that Transcriber 1.12 Batch is represented as WEB, with an optional JupyterLab
switch and camel-case input/output parameters. See the official documentation:
https://docs.cloud.sdu.dk/Apps/transcriber.html#transcriber-batch

Tests add explicitly synthetic enum options, defaults, optionality and compute-tool metadata.
Those additions are not claimed to have been captured from the live application.
